verdict.rationale: Noise suppression is a fair question for a realtime voice-agent framework, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack documents noise cancellation or audio filtering. The adaptive interruption handling, the turn detector and the general media-processing participants are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a documented noise-suppression capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls
